# FreeConvert.com

> > Free online file conversion service supporting audio, video, image, document, and ebook formats including MP3, MP4, MOV, PNG, PDF, EPUB, and hundreds more.

FreeConvert.com provides web-based conversion tools for transforming files between popular formats like WEBP, HEIC, JPG, GIF, SVG, OGG, DOCX, and JFIF. The platform offers converters in multiple languages including English, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, German, French, Portuguese, Spanish, Dutch, Polish, Swedish, and Indonesian.

## Key Topics

- File conversion
- Audio converter (MP3, FLAC, WAV, ALAC, AMR, WMA, OGG)
- Video converter (MP4, MOV, AVI, OGV)
- Image converter (PNG, JPG, WEBP, HEIC, GIF, SVG, JFIF)
- Document converter (PDF, DOCX, EPUB)
- Online converter tools
- Format conversion
- Media conversion
- 3G2 format conversion
- 3GA format conversion
- Mobile video formats (iPad Video, PSP Video)
- Multi-language support
- Browser-based conversion
- Free conversion service
